notes: Government funding scaffold. Replace with research-backed budgets later. Goal: transparent categories and flows.
principles: Tax work less, tax extraction more
Use automatic mechanisms where possible (no fear-based bureaucracy)
Tie revenue sources to public goods (education/health/infrastructure)

revenue_streams.name: Payroll / participation contribution
revenue_streams.why: ties to People’s Wealth Fund and retirement security

revenue_streams.name: Value-added/extraction tax
revenue_streams.who_pays: monopoly rents and excess margin sectors

revenue_streams.name: Carbon/energy externality fee (rebated)
revenue_streams.why: prices true costs while protecting households

revenue_streams.name: Financial transaction micro-levy
revenue_streams.why: reduces destabilizing speculation and funds public goods

revenue_streams.name: AI productivity levy (to People’s Wealth Fund)

where_money_is_generated: Natural resources (managed with public benefit rules)
how_capitalism_works_under_wmr: Markets allocate and innovate; extraction is capped
Competition is protected by anti-monopoly enforcement
Workers gain bargaining power via universal floors and dividend
Public infrastructure lowers business input costs
Capital can earn returns, but cannot buy the rules of society

collection_institutions_scaffold.option: No IRS as we know it (scaffold)
collection_institutions_scaffold.replacement: National Revenue Service focused on automatic withholding, simple filing, open dashboards, and narrow audits
public_protections: no surprise retroactive penalties without due process
right to see and correct records
